args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high) affects fastjson <2.9.4 via unbounded
recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Pin the minimum
fixed version 2.9.4.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary
- Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Rationale
- [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (severity: **high**): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
- Affected versions: `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`; fixed in `2.9.4` and `3.1.0`.
- Pinning the minimal fixed version `2.9.4` resolves the vulnerability while staying on the same major version.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**.
